title: 10 Mini Gadgets From Anker That Are Totally Worth Buying - BGR
summary: The Nano Power Bank 5K MagGo Slim (Amazon, $59.99) is a mouthful of a product name, but packs a lot of power into an almost credit-card-sized magnetic charging bank, attaching conveniently to your iPhone via the MagSafe on the rear.
